About me

I'm an education researcher and special educator in training. I finished my B.Ed. in Special Education at the Institute of Education and Research (IER), University of Dhaka, with a CGPA of 3.82, and I'm now pursuing an M.Ed. in Educational Evaluation and Research at the same institute.

Alongside my studies I worked as an intern teacher at Ramna Intellectually Disabled & Autistic School, where I handled daily coordination, records and reports, and helped run two large school events. I bring the same habits to research, fieldwork and operations: careful documentation, clear reporting and steady teamwork.
